other / uncategorized.text: This app is decent but it requires some improvements. Some pictures add too many arms or a piece of an arm or hand is added. Sometimes the arms or legs are too long for the body size. The hair feature mixes up the styles/textures or a portion of the hair hangs off. It would be nice to incorporate a few different heights and physical body types. The ai facial features are spot on at times. I would give it a higher star rating if it would fix the disfigured creature features.

Ads, ads, and more ads. This would be great if it had maybe one ad to watch but I got nailed with 3 just to see my images. Plus, after you watch, said ads, it doesn't let you X out. You have to keep fighting to back out. Keeps taking you to the ad download screen. I completely get you have to make money but come on. Other than that, the app does its job and creates beautiful images.

This app didn't provide anything for the images I was trying to enhance but their "free" trial is a scam! I downloaded it and signed up through Google but when I canceled it through Google this app charged me a weekly fee still because they sent a separate email for you to cancel through them as well if not you'll get a different charge. Totally useless and a rip off! I wish I could label it without stars.

Here's a natural-sounding 1-star review in English: ⭐☆☆☆☆ This app has way too many ads. Every time I try to use a feature, another ad pops up, making it almost impossible to edit my photos properly. The constant interruptions completely ruin the experience. I understand that free apps need ads, but this is just excessive. It feels like I spend more time watching ads than actually using the app. Please reduce the number of ads and improve the user experience.

Terrible user experience. The app is completely ruined by an overwhelming and aggressive amount of ads. I understand the free tier needs ads, but forcing long video ads after almost every single click is unacceptable. It makes the app completely unusable. Avoid it."
this is very good app for editing but one problem ad more than that limit so please add only one

I wish I could give 0 stars. To people who installed it for the 'LinkedIn' profile photo generated by AI, don't. Unless you can pay. It doesn't even allow you once. Also I tried to generate it while I was on a call, and it didn't work, I waited a lot. Then when my call ended, I restarted the app and it worked at last, only to come accross payment page whenever i clicked continue and when i closed the payment page it kept showing ads. Like, if you play ads, at least let me use the AI for ONCE.

The latest version is really annoying and unnecessary. The interface is confusing and i can't see the enhanced photos i did before. Not to mention now you only have 5x photo enhancing instead of 10x. You also can't enhance the 2nd time bcs its not "pro". And saving pictures need a full ad too??? It's getting out of hand, You guys clearly milking every ounce of profit out of this, it shows and it's stupid. Bring the old version back!

Fabulous app has made some blurred legacy photos into good family shots. Free version had a limit on the number of saves per day iirc, and the limit was enough for my needs at that time. I tried using it today and unfortunately it's no longer working, not loading my previous photos and not allowing me to download my new one, looks like maybe the creators want me to buy it... and it is (or rather was) a good app, just not that useful to me.

I downloaded it first and it was a really good app that does its job. It should have been a 5 star, but after a while I uninstalled it to free some memory and now it won't redownload again even though I have enough space on my phone and a stable internet connection. I also tried downloading it on another phone and it' still the same problem. Please fix this ASAP, thank you

Good, but needs improvement. One thing that I'd like to see worked on is the way face enhancement deals with facial details. For example, moles, spots, facial scars, freckles etc. It would be nice if the feature didn't make those details disappear. Like, some people actually like those things on their face, yet they always disappear when I use the app.

I have tried many AI photo enhancement applications. This one is the best. The result is very natural and realistic and very high quality. Other apps give paint-like results. Remini is perfect, Maybe a little glossy but not too much. I wish they would offer a single payment option. Renting an app is not useful unless you are a photographer and always use it.

Yes, this app does enhance your photos. Perhaps do very good quality works for some people. Yet, every time I click a single feature or a single option, they are asking for ads to use that feature. For example, when you click Enhance Face and then every option (1, 2, 3,etc) has each one ads. Not only that, when you click "Disable" for the said feature, it also show you an ads. I'm sorry. I understand you need ads for free user but I feel so uncomfortable with 70-80% my time viewing ads.

Actually a very good AI app for lots of fun with your pics and videos. I don't tend to use AI generated pictures besides just fun but I did end up putting one as my LinkedIn, as it was not too AI looking. I do wish there was a way to say - hey leave thos wrinkles and skin texture as is. Maybe a kind of a slider how much smoothing u want to happen could be provided? As that's usually what ends up being too "fake" looking. Anyway, still tons of fun and value for a free try out period.

I understand that apps if used for free does need ads to operate but the amount of ads appearing after every action is just unbelievable. I just wanted a clear photo, I don't even need a makeup or filter, it just needed to enhance photo quality, but even REMOVING the bg blur, face enhancement, etc. or literally every button push is followed by an ad. The app's features are good but the ads are just too disruptive. I've been trying to enhance 1 photo for more or less 30 minutes now.

I decided to go ahead and buy Remini as I wanted to enhance more than 5 photos per day (I have a ton of old photos that are scratched, etc). Unfortunately, once you pay for it, you suddenly get weird delays. "22,955 requests ahead, your task will be ready in a few minutes". I'm paying for this, why is there now a queue when there wasn't before? Yet, when I use the free version on my hubby's phone (just tested), I waited 30 seconds for the same thing! Don't waste your money on the non-free version. I regret my purchase.

This app is good but,I don't really like it cuz it just highlighting your image and adds a little few more pixels, it makes you to look fair in the edited one it's good to see but it's looking like graphic or something it's not so realistic to be honest it's like AniMe!!!And it asks for ad before every photo were gonna edit My suggestion is please don't highlight the photo,Just add more pixels when you edit this it looks like using a filter!

I can actually see my great-grandfather instead of a blurry old photo. I wish it could enhance the rest of the photo, not just the face. The color feature needs a lot of improvement. It just turns sections of the picture orange and that's it. Also, I wish there was a no eyelashes option. It keeps giving people thick full eyelashes where there aren't any.

The only thing that I don't like is that when you make a photo more "clearer" the photo should have a face it's very inconvenient for me: I love taking some random pictures like my pets and nature but I cannot enhance it using Remini because the photos don't have a "human face", I hope you guys will removed that kind of feature and bring back the old one.

I wish It does not limit to 5 downloads per day because I am willing to wait to see the ads just to enhance my photo. And I hope I can do this in videos without paying. But I really love how they enhance the pictures. This is the best photo enhancer ever. Wish that I could do it to all of my photos without limiting it to only 5 photos per day

Amazing experience using it. Have enhanced at least 300+ photos by now! One major suggestion though. A "render queue" feature would be very very useful if you want to do a lot of images at once. Its very tiresome for me to process the photos one by one while having to wait for the initianalization process. If you could add the queue feature it would be great. I'd pay for it tbh

Best photo enhancing app, I have to give them credit for it, but it's really annoying to wait for 5 tokens every 23 hours to enhance a photo I really wish there was an option to watch ads for free to tokens, think about it the advertisers will pay the app more money😉💯✋Plus the "free tokens" Watch a video and get them free is a waste of time they don't even give you the free token. 😥

I use the paid version. This can be really fun to play with, but it glitches a lot and the core options (filters? commands? - don't know what to call them) arent great. My biggest annoyance, however, is the logo. I'm not posting these anywhere - so it doesn't serve as advertisement, all that it does is ruin some great images/elements. I wish there were a way to scale the edit down to your liking. Also, it pretty much ALWAYS screws up teeth.  They look horrible, especially when there are kids in a photo. pricing / subscription.text: It's a decent photo enhancer, but nothing special. You only get to enhance 5 photos a day unless you get their pro subscription, which sucks because I'm a photographer/artist and it would be nice if it didn't take 6 days to enhance all of my photos. Plus, the enhancer itself is really wonky; most of the time it just weirdly smooths everything out, putting many things into the uncanny valley. Overall, it's an okay app. Nothing great, but it's not bad.

It has been almost a week now since I have been experiencing an error in Remini. It keeps saying "something went wrong. Please check you internet connection and try again later.". My app is up to date and so as my phone software. I am paying a weekly subscription and now I am unable to use this. I contacted thee help center and they have not responded except for they don't know what's wrong. I will need a refund.

It is very good but it works out very expensive I'm sure it would sell much better if the price was more reasonable like £10 a month instead of £10 a week, the price is a bit frightening enough to put me off. Works better on old B&W photos than old colour photos. I can't give 5 stars only because of price. Paint shop and Photo shop (expenive one buy) works out cheaper but more tricky and you need a PC. It's less time consuming than the computer software available.

The paint feature is good for the most part, it messes up people's faces sometimes, I wish there was a way to tweak it a bit. But I'm only putting 3 stars because you only get 5 images free per day and you have to watch a 30 sec ad for each one, and then it still says 70 tasks ahead of yours! Please give more free ones (Im happy to watch an ad each time but let me do more a day!) or reduce the monthly subscription because I can't afford it!

This app has gone downhill. It was amazing in the earlier days, it was my go-to app. I wish it was kept the same as it was in 2019. Now there are so many unnecessary things added in to keep up with the trendy "Ai generated photos". The weekly price for the Lite version is around $10 and for the Pro version, it's nearly $18 weekly. I wouldn't mind paying $18 if it was for a month, but weekly? No thank you.

i wish this app didn't have that many ads it genuinely is amazing, but there's so many ads to do the simplests of tasks and you can't even skip you just have to sit through a bunch of 30s ads, and if you don't want ads, you can't even buy the program, you have to subscribe and keep paying for it as long as you're using it, seriously subscription has a time and place you can't just make a program that solves one problem and then put a subscription plan for it, I'm not gonna use it daily.

Excellent...Give very accurate results most of the times. I wish they would charge one time price, instead of subscription. Adobe lost its big clientele that way. A slight glitch is that when refining portraits and family photos, it at times, converts the eyes into light brown and bluish or grey, instead of original black. That sounds a bit unfair to Asians. No more attractive free version

This app has the most annoying ads of all. you should adjust your subscription price as this app is not that essential for daily use. Maybe, offer a mini sub. like 1-day-use subscription. that would be nice. but right now, I couldn't find this up worthy yet. it's not even that accurate. it keeps making everyone feminine.

I subscribed for 3 months. Then I noticed they've charged me again for an extra subscription for a month even though I'm already subscribed for 3. 😠 Generic responses to emails don't help, js. Hoping I get a refund on the extra sub! It's an otherwise great app, happy with it. Would be nice to have more than 5 pro cards in a month!!

I am a paid subscriber to this app and I have to say this is the best colorizer available that I have found and I have used about 12 other ones. The features included (even the free version with ads) are really very good. I do a lot of photo editing , especially old nostalgia type colour conversions and the results are very impressive. You wont find a better colorizer anywhere in my opinion. I use it on my phone and also on my Windows PC by installing the programme on Bluestacks which is a really good Android emulator. If you have used Bluestacks before and stopped using it, well worth a revisit. I would certainly recommend Remini highly...................... UPDATE!!!! A lot of the above review is no longer relevant, all we have now is unblur which can be overdone very easily leaving some very scary faces. There are countless other alternatives to do the colouring part but it would be better and less expensive to have it all in one place and on one app. It would also help if it were possible to be able to adjust the sharpening/enhancement with a slider. The face enhancement should include all of the hair not half of it sometimes. Very hard to fix the hair after enhancement. I do a lot of old black and white photographs. I often find it a better colourising output if I soften the face after sharpening slightly to take out the harsh with a liquidise sharpening reduction with PS or Gimp. Complete garments need to be recognised better to reduce the multi colour effects on them.

Awesome way to clear up old photos or blurry photos of faces. I was impressed. However my needs are more along the lines of blurry nature photos of animals. My spouse has lits of old family pictures that it has been great for. It would be worth it for the yearly price if you wanted great facial images of your old photos. The ads on the free version are long and cringy lol. Overall I was impressed. Would pay yearly if I personally needed it.

batch / bulk processing.text:
I paid for a week of Remini AI photos expecting stylized versions of MYSELF, not random AI women wearing toddler roller skates, sitting in strawberry fields, hiding in teddy bears, or looking like Celine Dion’s emotionally unavailable cousin.

The app constantly generated faces, bodies, hair, makeup, and expressions that barely resembled me at all. Every batch looked like the same generic AI influencer template with different costumes pasted on top.

The advertising makes it seem like you upload selfies and get polished cinematic portraits of yourself. What you actually get is uncanny valley stock-photo strangers wearing your skin as a suggestion.

The interface is also terrible. Projects get stuck, photos reload repeatedly, deleting images doesn’t actually clear the generation, and it’s extremely confusing trying to generate new looks versus reopening old ones.

For nine dollars, this was honestly ridiculous. If you want realistic enhancement of actual photos, this app is not it.
